let meets_substantial_presence_test (days_current_year : int) (days_first_preceding_year : int) (days_second_preceding_year : int) : bool =
  let weighted_day_sum =
    float_of_int days_current_year *. 1.0 +.
    float_of_int days_first_preceding_year *. (1.0 /. 3.0) +.
    float_of_int days_second_preceding_year *. (1.0 /. 6.0)
  in
  days_current_year >= 31 &&
  weighted_day_sum >= 183.0

module Substantial_presence_test = struct
  (* 7701(b)(3)(A): base substantial presence test, formalized in sub-provision *)
  let meets_substantial_presence_test = meets_substantial_presence_test

  (* 7701(b)(3)(B): exception - present under 183 days in current year and closer connection to a foreign tax home *)
  let closer_connection_exception (days_current_year : int) (has_tax_home_in_foreign_country : bool) (sec_911_d_3 : bool) (* cross-ref: §911(d)(3) *) (has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country : bool) : bool =
    days_current_year < 183 &&
    sec_911_d_3 &&
    has_tax_home_in_foreign_country &&
    has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country

  (* 7701(b)(3)(C): exception to (B) - pending adjustment of status or steps toward lawful permanent residency *)
  let closer_connection_exception_inapplicable (has_pending_adjustment_of_status_application : bool) (took_steps_to_apply_for_lawful_permanent_resident_status : bool) : bool =
    has_pending_adjustment_of_status_application ||
    took_steps_to_apply_for_lawful_permanent_resident_status

  (* 7701(b)(3)(D): exempt individual or medical-condition days excluded from presence day count used in (A) *)
  let is_excluded_presence_day (is_exempt_individual : bool) (unable_to_leave_due_to_medical_condition_arising_while_present : bool) : bool =
    is_exempt_individual ||
    unable_to_leave_due_to_medical_condition_arising_while_present
end
